gamma_events.title: Highest temperature in Munich on August 2?

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: The observed high temperature at New York City’s primary reference station, LaGuardia Airport (KLGA), reached exactly 86°F on August 1, 2026, according to National Weather Service climatological reports, driving the market’s near-certain consensus on the 86–87°F bin. This outcome aligns with NWS forecast guidance issued the prior day calling for a peak near 84–86°F under partly sunny skies and southwesterly flow, consistent with typical late-summer conditions and the station’s 1991–2020 normal high of 86°F. With official observations now finalized and no reported measurement revisions, traders have converged on this result. A data correction from the National Weather Service or a switch to an alternate station such as Central Park or JFK could theoretically alter resolution, though such adjustments remain rare once daily summaries are published.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Tokyo Haneda Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 4 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Tokyo Haneda Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/jp/tokyo/RJTT.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Latest Japan Meteorological Agency forecasts for Tokyo on August 4 project a mostly cloudy day with a maximum near 28°C, driving the tight market clustering around 28–29°C outcomes. Persistent cloud cover from a strengthening Pacific high is expected to limit surface heating and solar insolation compared with clearer summer patterns, while moderate humidity and light winds further moderate peak readings. Ensemble model spreads show only modest day-to-day variability, keeping 30°C or higher probabilities low at under 20% combined. Traders are weighting the official guidance heavily because resolution relies on JMA station measurements, with any last-minute clearing or stronger subsidence potentially shifting the high by 1°C. Updated model runs and the agency’s morning briefing on August 3 remain the key near-term catalysts.
